method: Fresh process per sample, one warmup. Solve only: excludes parsing, setup, and printing. Exact ordered solutions checked against independent backtracking; prefix search also verified for N=1..8.

definitions.permutations:
Columns = 0 till 8 array
fun Q safe rank 1
  Up = Q + Columns unique len
  if Up not equal 8
    return false
  end
  Down = Q - Columns unique len
  return Down equal 8
end
definitions.prefixes:
fun N queens
  Cols = 0 till N array
  States = array shape 1 N fill 0

  for Row in 0 till N
    Prefix = States # (0 till Row)
    Free = Prefix available rank 1
    Size = (States len) * N
    Flat = Free reshape Size
    Index = Flat indices

    if Index len equal 0
      return array shape 0 N fill 0
    end

    States = States (Index // N) copy
    States # Row = Index mod N
  end
  return States

  fun Q available
    Depth = Q len
    Rows = 0 till Depth array
    Dy = Depth - Rows
    Dx = Cols Q outer - abs
    Hit = Dx equal 0 or Dx equal Dy
    return not (Hit any axis 1)
  end
end

solves.permutations: Solutions = Columns permutations filter safe copy
